gloss: name and reality; reputation and substance

definitions.gloss: name and reality; both in name and in fact
definitions.explanation: The relationship between what something is called or reputed to be and what it actually is. Formed from {名|めい} (name) and {実|じつ} (reality, substance). Almost always used in the set phrase {名実|めいじつ}ともに.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{名実|めいじつ}とも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a leader both in name and in fact.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{名実|めいじつ}とも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧だ。
examples.english: This shop is number one in the area, both in reputation and in reality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}して→優勝する：25496_yuushousuru⟧、{名実|めいじつ}とも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{日本一|にほんいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧になった。
examples.english: By winning the championship, they became the best team in Japan in both name and substance.

notes:
Nearly always appears in the fixed adverbial phrase {名実|めいじつ}とも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (both in name and in reality), used to stress that a title or reputation is fully matched by the facts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名実|めいじつ}とも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: both in name and in fact
- {名実|めいじつ}{相伴|あいともな}う: for name and substance to go together

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}→有名無実：06459_yuumeimujitsu⟧: nominal; in name only — the opposite situation, where reputation is not backed by reality.
- ⟦{実質|じっしつ}→実質：12282_jisshitsu⟧: substance; essence — focuses on the actual content rather than the name.
